description: Work out what this user can speak to with authority, from what they have published, who is in their network, what they have been reading, and their profile — in that order of weight. Use this instead of asking them for keywords: they should never have to type a search query. Returns topics each carrying the source it came from and a short reason, plus `sentence`, one line naming what was picked and why, which you must show the user before anything you found. When `enough_to_go_on` is false there was too little to read and you should say so plainly and ask them what they care about, once — never guess.
name: my_topics
title: What I can speak to
